known_before_freeze.scope: retrospective train-date folds 1 and 2; mechanism-development evidence only

algorithm.source_measure: q on source support S from a matched ASCENT predictor
algorithm.target_support: T and target-free risk r from a complementary ASCENT predictor
algorithm.support_cost: ADE/ADE_SCALE + FDE/FDE_SCALE between source and target atoms
algorithm.permutation_posterior: rho(sigma) proportional to exp(-sum_i q_i C_i,sigma(i)) over all K! bijections
algorithm.projection: argmin over simplex p: p^T r - 0.5 p^T D p + KL(p||u)
algorithm.top1_decision: target-support decision rule fixed before evaluation

hypotheses.H1: MABPT improves Energy Score over matched ASCENT on confirmatory data.
hypotheses.H2: MABPT fixed-event NLL and Brier are noninferior to matched ASCENT within a 1 percent relative margin.
hypotheses.H3: MABPT improves conflict-risk discrimination or calibration without degrading the other endpoint beyond a 1 percent relative margin.

design.confirmatory_data: sealed official and external splits; opened once after all configurations pass smoke tests
design.experimental_unit: calendar date or flight, never overlapping actor windows
design.bootstrap: paired hierarchical airport then date then flight/scene, 10000 replicates
design.multiplicity: Holm correction across H1-H3; ablations are secondary
design.effect_reporting: absolute and relative paired effect, 95 percent CI, raw and adjusted p value

fixed_event_definition.thresholds: estimated once from training data and hashed before development evaluation

stopping_rule: Report every fixed seed and every registered arm. Failed arms remain in the registry. No configuration changes after confirmatory data are opened.
claim_boundary: Legacy C165 evidence is retrospective. MABPT may be described as a standalone algorithm, but external generalization, calibration, and traffic-decision claims require completed E1-E13 evidence.
